    Come From Away

    October 30,31 November 6,7,8*,13,14,15*,20,21, 2026

    Friday and Saturday performances @ 7:30pm

    *Sunday matinees @ 2pm

    Directed by: Dawn Yamokoski

    Music Directed by: Heidi Herczeg

    Music & Lyrics: Irene Sankoff and David Hein

    Produced by special arrangement with: Music Theatre International

    Come From Away is the inspiring true story of what happened when 38 planes were forced to land unexpectedly in the tiny town of Gander, Newfoundland, after the events of September 11, 2001. With their town suddenly filled with thousands of stranded passengers from around the world, the people of Gander opened their homes—and their hearts—to complete strangers.

    It’s a heartfelt, funny, and uplifting story about kindness, community, and the unexpected connections that can bring people together when the world feels divided.
